x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Every Kalshi and prediction-market capability the Group holds works as one system whose predictions on events it already covers get more accurate, not merely more varied.

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall compose every Kalshi and prediction-market capability the Group holds in its repositories, with no parallel predictor beside it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "find all kalshi code from here github other repo and get it all consolidated and working together as part of one ssytem".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall report, per event class, the Brier score of each new predictor against the predictor it replaces on the same events.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "keep making it do DIDFFERENT predicitons not MORE BETTER predicitons".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall live in the Group's Kalshi repository and not only in the local monorepo.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "not just, locked in this local monorepo when we are meant to, and do have, entire repo about kalshi on github".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall perform its arithmetic in code and call a language model for no calculation.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "we will NEVER profit if we have to pay Claude inference for simple arithmetic".

requirements.says: Where the Group holds a free cloud-compute account, the Kalshi system shall be able to offload its computations to it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "any cloud provider accounts with free compute we can use, we shuold use them".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall take its strategies, rules, arena and players from the Group's shared typed vocabulary for those four.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "make things close to shared typed strategies, rules, arena, players, i.e. that all our ecosystem uses".

conditions.says: A consolidation inventory naming every Kalshi capability and its disposition exists.
Each event class carries the new and the prior Brier score.
The Kalshi repository exists on GitHub and holds the system.
The system's source calls no model provider.
The package depends on the shared typed vocabulary package.

board-opening.context: Codex held a Kalshi session and a weather session at the time of the first message; the Leader then stopped the other agents and asked for one system. The consolidated system lives in red-cup-engineering/kalshi-engineering-services-section (engineering); the Group's trading on it is the Kalshi determined-outcome record. The scope path is the mounted gitlink (its .gitmodules url is red-cup-engineering/kalshi-engineering-services-section); the receiving verdict of 2026-10-09 notes that pull requests deleting kalshi-services-section carry no per-deletion record of where the capability now lives (note, line 117).
